lines: To see his mama, I've boarded a train alone today
Riding off by myself on the train
The dusk closes in on rows of houses and streams of cars
I watch them pass me by from the corner of my eye
By now he's bound to notice
A message in lipstick, left in the bathroom
Unless he gives up his fickle love soon
I won't come home
Leaving my anxious feelings behind, still as they are
The town rings Ding-Dong, fading into the distance
Tomorrow morning, Mama will call him up
And give him a scolding, My Darling!
By now he's sure to be panicking
A message in lipstick, left in the bathroom
I wonder if he'll ask my friends, one after another
Where I've gone
Leaving my anxious feelings behind, still as they are
The town rings Ding-Dong, fading into the distance
Tomorrow morning, Mama will call him up
And give him a scolding, My Darling!
And give him a scolding, My Darling!
